mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.notice_id, a.notice_title, a.notice_type, a.notice_content, a.STATUS, a.publish_time, a.receive_end, a.valid_time, a.invalid_time, a.if_all_receive, a.receive_depts, a.receive_roles, a.receive_users, CONVERT ( a.notice_banner, CHAR ) notice_banner, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.tenant_id, b.tenant_name, a.industry_code, ic.industry_name, a.app_ver_code, ivc.app_ver_name, t.NICK_NAME as createByName FROM sys_notice a LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and b.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON a.industry_code = ic.industry_code and ic.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_industry_ver_conf ivc ON ivc.app_ver_code = a.app_ver_code AND ivc.industry_code = a.industry_code LEFT JOIN sys_user t ON t.USER_NAME = a.create_by and t.DEL_FLAG = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into sys_notice ( notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, remark, create_by, dept_id, publish_time, valid_time, invalid_time, if_all_receive, receive_depts, receive_roles, receive_users, notice_banner, tenant_id, receive_end, app_ver_code, industry_code, create_time )values( #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{noticeContent}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{deptId}, #{publishTime}, #{validTime}, #{inValidTime}, #{ifAllReceive}, #{receiveDepts}, #{receiveRoles}, #{receiveUsers}, #{noticeBanner}, #{tenantId}, #{receiveEnd}, #{appVerCode}, #{industryCode}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: select count(0) from sys_notice_read where NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} and USER_ID = #{userId}

mapper.select:
select notice_id, notice_title, notice_type, notice_content, status, publish_time, receive_end, valid_time, invalid_time, if_all_receive, receive_depts, receive_roles, receive_users, notice_banner, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, dept_id, tenant_id, (SELECT if(count(1)>=1 ,1,0) FROM sys_notice_read A WHERE A.NOTICE_ID = T.NOTICE_ID and A.USER_ID = #{userId}) as ifRead from sys_notice T where T.status='1' AND T.receive_end like '%2%'
and T.NOTICE_TYPE = #{noticeType}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_read A WHERE A.NOTICE_ID = T.NOTICE_ID AND A.USER_ID = #{userId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_read A WHERE A.NOTICE_ID = T.NOTICE_ID AND A.USER_ID = #{userId})
AND ( INSTR(T.RECEIVE_USERS, #{userId})>0 OR INSTR(T.RECEIVE_DEPTS, #{deptId})>0 OR (T.IF_ALL_RECEIVE = '1' AND ( T.DEPT_ID =#{deptId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_DEPT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID=#{deptId} AND INSTR(D.ANCESTORS, T.DEPT_ID)>0 ) ) ) ) ORDER BY T.PUBLISH_TIME DESC

select count(0) from sys_notice T where T.status='1' AND T.receive_end like '%2%' AND current_timestamp between T.VALID_TIME and T.INVALID_TIME AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_read A WHERE A.NOTICE_ID = T.NOTICE_ID AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}) AND ( INSTR(T.RECEIVE_USERS, #{userId})>0 OR INSTR(T.RECEIVE_DEPTS, #{deptId})>0 OR (T.IF_ALL_RECEIVE = '1' AND ( T.DEPT_ID =#{deptId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_DEPT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID=#{deptId} AND INSTR(D.ANCESTORS, T.DEPT_ID)>0 ) ) ) )
